description: This file defines an interface 'ConnectionFailure' for representing internal messaging errors related to connection failures within the Eclipse Ditto project. It declares methods to retrieve failure descriptions and failure objects, and extends another interface 'WithOrigin'.

classes.name: ConnectionFailure
classes.description: An interface representing a connection failure event with methods to access failure details.

methods.name: getFailureDescription
methods.description: Returns the description of the connection failure.

methods.name: getFailure
methods.description: Returns the Failure object containing the cause, as per Akka's Status.Failure.
